prompt: Create a 1970s black-and-white close-up portrait in a windswept outdoor setting, black and white noise . Camera/look: eye-level, front ¾ view (~30° off-axis); 85–105 mm portrait perspective; vertical 2:3, tight head-and-shoulders crop; shallow DoF f/2.8–f/4; subject centered . Lighting: hard natural sunlight from upper camera-left with minimal fill; crisp shadows; subtle rim on hair; sky as bright mid-tone background; no blown highlights.Pose & expression: subject faces camera, chin slightly down, lips parted with a cigarette held between them; gaze relaxed/half-lidded; hair blown across the face by wind, partially covering one eye.Wardrobe & styling: dark collared shirt with open neck; thin black neck scarf tied loosely; no logos/jewelry.Grade: high-contrast monochrome with rich blacks, bright highlights, medium–heavy film grain (Tri-X/HP5 vibe), slight halation, faint vignette; keep skin texture natural (no plastic smoothing).Composition: simple sky background, no extra props; clean verticals; ensure sharp focus on near eye and cigarette.Output: high-resolution, editorial/classic cinema mood; no text or watermarks.

promptZh: 创作一张 1970 年代的黑白特写肖像，背景为 风中户外环境，带有黑白噪点。相机/视觉：平视角度，正面 ¾ 视角（偏离轴线约 30°）；85–105 mm 肖像透视；垂直 2:3 比例，紧凑的头部和肩部裁剪；浅景深 f/2.8–f/4；主体居中。光影：来自相机左上方强烈的自然阳光，补光极少；阴影清晰；发丝边缘光细腻；天空作为明亮的中调背景；无过曝高光。姿势与表情：主体面向相机，下巴微垂，双唇微张，衔着一支香烟；眼神放松/半闭；风吹乱头发遮住脸庞，部分遮挡一只眼睛。服装与造型：深色翻领衬衫，领口敞开；系着一条松散的黑色细领巾；无标志/珠宝。调色：高对比度黑白，黑色深邃，高光明亮，中等到重度的胶片颗粒感（Tri-X/HP5 风格），轻微的光晕，淡淡的暗角；保持皮肤纹理自然（无塑料感平滑）。构图：简洁的天空背景，无额外道具；垂直线条干净；确保近处的眼睛和香烟焦点清晰。输出：高分辨率，编辑/经典电影质感；无文字或水印。
